summary: A balance row's `ledger_id` foreign-key lookup must fall back to the balance's own resolved code when no matching `ledger` row is found yet, because `sync` runs resources concurrently and the `ledger` table is not guaranteed to have committed before `ledger-balances` processes -- nothing else in this codebase depends on `ledger_id` being the true numeric id.
reason: Even after fixing the resource-name-to-table remap, the lookup depended on `ledger` having already committed the matching row. Confirmed live via interleaved sync progress events that `ledger` and `ledger-balances` sync concurrently, so the lookup legitimately misses on a real full sync some of the time.
validated_outcome: Live full sync no longer errors or drops balance rows when ledger-balances processes a code before the matching ledger row has committed.
